status: SOURCED history and owners; FITTED hazard; calibration SIMULATED. Nothing here has run in the game.

window.decision: after each season 1999-2025 the club either keeps the coach who opened that season or opens the next one with another (the last decision picked the 2026 coach); Houston starts in 2002

nflverse_games.title: nflverse nfldata games.csv
nflverse_games.use: head coach of every club's games and the season records, 1999-2025 only
nflverse_games.licence: no licence declared in the repository; only facts (dates, scores, coach names) are used

wikipedia_owners.title: List of current NFL franchise owners
wikipedia_owners.use: principal owner, since when, and the note that separates a family succession from a purchase

wikipedia_2026_season.title: 2026 NFL season
wikipedia_2026_season.use: the table of 2026 offseason head coach changes: who left, why and when

teams_2026.title: the repo's sourced 2026 head coaches
teams_2026.use: the 2026 opening-day head coach of each club; the announcement URL of each is in history.current

rules.owner_era: an outside purchase after 1999 starts a new owner era (the club's earlier coaching decisions say nothing about him); a family succession, a founding family or a public owner does not
rules.owner_scale: fire_scale_q8 = 256 * (changes + k) / (expected_changes + k) over the owner's era, k = model.fit.frailty.shape; a club with no decisions under its owner yet (Seattle) is exactly 256. A smaller k widens the spread of owners (the data do not support one smaller than the stored k), a larger k narrows it
rules.reading: 1.00 (256) is the league's average temper; above it the owner fires sooner than the league does for the same record and tenure, below it later
rules.departure: the 2026 offseason's ten head coach departures carry reason, date and a news source; every other change is derived from game data only

model.name: owner_fire_hazard/v1
model.formula: idx = ((2*W+T)*17 + G)//(2*G); b = 0 if n<=1, 1 if n==2, else 2; p = base_permille[b][idx]; p = (p*owner_q8*league_q8 + 32768) >> 16; p = min(p, 1000); fire when (draw % 1000) < p
model.tenure_bucket: n = seasons with the club including the season just played; 0 first season, 1 second, 2 third or later

fit.kind: logistic regression on the season win percentage (centred at .500) with one intercept per tenure group
fit.playoffs: made-the-playoffs and won-a-playoff-game add nothing once the win percentage is known (2 df likelihood ratio 2.4); the model does not use them

frailty.rule: no spread between clubs beyond records and tenure: smallest shape not rejected at 95%

league.tenure_note: tenure columns exclude the coaches who opened 1999 (their start is not in the data)

crosscheck_r2.method: coach of the club's last game of each season; consecutive seasons 1999-2025 (r2 prototype)
crosscheck_r2.why_not_used: an in-season firing is counted against the previous season's record and its interim replacement counts again; nflverse has no interim coaches in 2024 and 2025

calibration.records_basis: the real regular-season record of every club and season 1999-2025 (nflverse games.csv); the simulation gives each of its 32 clubs the sequence of a random real club from a random start, wrapping around, so the spread, tails and persistence of records are real

real.tenure_note: tenure columns exclude the coaches who opened 1999 (their start is not in the data)

replay_on_real_seasons.note: every real club season weighted by its chance of dismissal under the final table (owner scales included, integers)

simulation_r2_headline.note: the r2 research quoted 8 changes a year counting the coach at the end of each season, which counts a mid-season firing and the hire that replaces the interim as two; set model.league_q8 to this value to get that rate
